density_note: Contours enclose 50/75/90% of the estimated density over the backward particles. They describe where this transport model places the mass and inherit its assumptions; a tight contour means the model is confident, not that the answer is certain.
note: Envelope width grows with hours-back because release time, duration and diffusivity are unknown. It is not converging on a point source. At the longest lookbacks the outer contour runs past the frame: the envelope genuinely extends beyond the imagery, and is drawn clipped rather than truncated to fit.
